Wave 55 (2026-10-11 → 2026-10-13; the closing gate wave55-final launched on tree 5a4ab5d4; its hash of record was read with HEAD at 26cd6610, a records-only commit). Seven lanes from BACKLOG's refilled obligations (f)-(o): L1 hyphen-ios-linebox (NB-ios, Blink's rounded line box on iOS), L2 cbb-android (ContainingBlockBands re-landed + PercentContentBoxBand), L3 positioned-parent-slot (PositionedParentSlotGate + PositionedParentRtlOrigin), L4 ua-heading-margin (the UA .67em-family block margin of an out-of-flow heading + the held folded-host face, both natives), L5 counter-suffix-rows (ListMarkerBidi, ListMarkerSuffixGap outside / inside on both natives, tabular digits on iOS, the SUFFIX NOTE), L6 android-paint-order (BehindContentBorder, the legacy Compose border sides behind content, the FO pin), L7 instruments (wire-differential, ab-arms55, spec 03 §4.1 citations, 21 pins, the marker-paint decline). 27 units landed (b4f64963..5bbc2a41) after a combined-tree skeptic (CLAIM-HOLDS, no must-fix), on a full sweep green.

STAGE 1 (wave55-pre, 9 sections, tree 0fd26479) decided five reverts under the pre-registered rules: L1 NB-ios (rule 1: hyphenate-character-002 ios P 0.9534 → f 0.9165, a lost carrier — the no-visible-hyphen host's lines tighten under the rounded line box; the 001 / 003 / 004 gains, 004 a flip, given up with it) and all four L4 units (rule 3: inset-005 / -006 below the 0.95 floor on both natives, ios 0.93 / 0.9284, android 0.9147 ×2; rule 4: the [M] band 5 px high — the 2em face is present now but the whole heading sits at cap top y138 vs the ref's y143 on both natives; the probe-time arm drop-L4-U2 measured U1 alone at the expectation's arm M to the third decimal; 014's f → P flips on both natives withdrawn with the units, their face-ink reads WRONG). L2, L3, L5, L6 kept after recorded looks on the cross-rasterizer and residual-only lines: the L3 rtl-rows component read compared with a base whose own picture was the defect (the stray '0' outside the box) and gained the decided device picture as a second reference; the L5 letter-profile read (0.80 vs the ref's alef, 0.88 vs its bet, on the RIGHT picture) gained the device's own letters plus a same-capture duplicate read; five device pictures became residual window sources (recorded, re-derived on --check; a window pixel equal to the decided picture is accepted at tolerance 0); the [K] ios zone starts at x137 (U3-ios's period fringe at x136, 1 px outside the Catalyst-measured boxes). Every edit proven able to fail on the device pictures (19 fakes, 0 violations) and on the standing fake sets (probes-selfcheck HOLDS, 28 / 28 gating keys able to fail). STAGE 2 (wave55-probe, 26 sections, tree aaf51b1b): no rule fired; the three L6 may-move stems beyond the band (descendant-static-position-001 / -002, break-inside-avoid-child android) show the pre-registered picture — the border band now under its child, as the ref — and were encoded as recorded looks (probe-decisions/looks.json) once adjudicate's R5, which has no may-move class, failed the closing record on exactly them.

CLOSING GATE wave55-final: 30 / 30 sections, full columns; hash of record android ecafaf0d MATCH, ios ff158a4e MATCH (= the probe's digests: no runtime source changed between the probe and the gate). The fixture net: refused once on the corpus run's own teardown load (never --force), then exit 7 on a transient empty Android column of composition-test (attempt 1), then exit 0 on all nine fixtures with a logcat tap showing no harness crash (attempt 2; R8). Read-out: R6 geometry exit 0 (gating 28 / 28), union control HOLDS (web identical; ios 4 changed = 4 carriers; android 82 changed = 49 carriers + 32 may-move + 1 ring-fenced; wire identical), probe → final rc 0, adjudicate R1–R5 hold after the looks, probe-readout 0 leak signals — FINAL READ-OUT HOLDS. PER-CELL DIFF wave55-open → wave55-final: gained 2 (selectors/dir-style-02a android f 0.9425 → P 0.9854; filter-effects/backdrop-filter-nested-border-radius-clip-3 android f 0.9574 → P 0.9999), LOST 0, 14 movers ≥ 0.005, every one a carrier or a looked-at may-move stem, all Android: clip / -2 / -4 to 1.000 / 1.000 / 0.9999; safe-001 / -002 0.9943 / 0.9932; descendant-static-position-001 / -002 0.9991 / 0.9724 and break-inside-avoid-child 0.9872 (the three looked-at may-move stems); abspos-autopos-htb-rtl 0.9966; bidi-tab-001 0.9929; anchor-position-multicol-nested-001 f 0.9688 and the three semi-replaced stretch-* L2 carriers, up and still f. Read under the threshold: dynamic-offset-rtl-001 / vrl-rtl-001 android to 1.000, counter-suffix ios 0.992 / android 0.9924, css3-counter-styles-005 ios 0.9971, and the ring-fenced basic-blur android +0.0036 (report only). Cell review: 57 cells read on the PNGs (12 first readers + 51 adversarial second readers): FAITHFUL 21 · DEGENERATE 25 · HONEST_FAIL 11; the two gains and the wave's claimed movers FAITHFUL on both reads; one label change — counter-suffix ios FAITHFUL → DEGENERATE on row 1's proportional '1', the pre-registered [L] report row (final/cell-review.json). Arm drop-L6-U2: 7 / 7 sections, android MATCH / ios MATCH; dropping U2 against the final moves exactly its attributed cells (safe-001 / -002 −0.0324 / −0.0297, descendant-static-position-002 / -001 −0.0123 / −0.0099, basic-blur −0.0036 ring-fenced), no P → f revealed (final/ab-drop-L6-U2.txt).

HONEST LOSSES AND MISSES: L1's NB-ios and all of L4 reverted (five of 27 units; their predicted gains — 004 ios, 014 ios / android, 005 / 006 — not delivered); the instrument's stage-1 misses are named in PLAN §10 items 10-12 and ship-notes §1 item 6 (a same-renderer read whose reference was the defect; a cross-font letter profile; a Catalyst-measured carve-out 1 px short on the device; residual windows for three-colour corners; --check re-deriving without its device sources). Instrument events: the readers' records had to be regenerated or adapted after the stage-1 regeneration (final55-analysis.gen, readers-calibration, probes-selfcheck's withdrawn keys, fix-r6.zones' recorded --also sources); the may-move look needed a generator input the plan had not provided (looks.json); the fixture net's first attempt lost its Android column on one fixture (transient).
